evidence.evidence: Manual inspection of all six book openings and printed page 75 (scan 109), where Book IV verse 358 contains τριβάδας. Use the principal printed numeral, preserving the bracketed alternative in this evidence. First1K's book attributes disagree with those headings for 4, 5, and 6; this is a permutation, not a global offset. Verse numbering, section levels, document order, and all readings remain unchanged.
